calibration_sources: LoRA Learns Less and Forgets Less (Biderman et al., Full Fine-Tuning vs LoRA Capacity Frontiers on Continual Pre-Training)
GaLore: Memory-Efficient LLM Training by Gradient Low-Rank Projection & Warmup-Stable-Decay (WSD) CPT Schedules
DARE-TIES (Drop And REscale + Trim, Elect Sign & Merge) Task-Arithmetic Model Merging for Mitigating Catastrophic Forgetting

workload.domain_corpus: 20 Billion Tokens of Proprietary Enterprise Domain Corpus (Semiconductor Verilog / Clinical Trials / Financial Law)

tiers.name: Tier 1: 纯领域数据全参数微调 Full-FT (0% 回放 -> 灾难性遗忘 -28.4 pts)
tiers.name_en: Tier 1: Naive 100% Domain Full-Parameter CPT/SFT (Zero Replay -> -28.4pt Forgetting)
tiers.training_mechanism: Full-Parameter AdamW (FP32 Master Weights + m/v States) on 100% Domain Data with Uniform LR=1e-4
tiers.forgetting_defense: None (Severe early-epoch gradient shock overwrites pre-trained instruction & reasoning circuits)
tiers.recommended_for: Never use 100% pure domain full-parameter fine-tuning without replay or model merging (destroys general instruction following and costs $25.8K).

tiers.name: Tier 2: 低秩适配器 QLoRA / DoRA (Rank=64 -> 学得会格式，装不下 20B 海量新知识)
tiers.name_en: Tier 2: Parameter-Efficient QLoRA / DoRA (Rank=64 -> Hits FFN Knowledge Capacity Wall)
tiers.training_mechanism: 4-bit/BF16 Frozen Base Weights + Trainable Low-Rank Matrices (r=64, alpha=128) on Attention & FFN
tiers.forgetting_defense: Base weights frozen (General retention 83.8%), but rank-64 bottleneck cannot absorb 20B tokens of new facts
tiers.recommended_for: Small-scale task format / tone / JSON style adaptation (<100M tokens); unsuitable for injecting billions of tokens of novel domain knowledge.

tiers.name: Tier 3: 全参数 CPT + 25% 通用数据回放 + WSD 退火 + Embedding 0.1x 降速解耦
tiers.name_en: Tier 3: Full-Param CPT + 25% General Replay + WSD Schedule + 0.1x Embedding LR
tiers.training_mechanism: Full-Parameter ZeRO-3/HFSDP + 75% Domain / 25% General Replay Mix + Warmup-Stable-Decay (WSD) + 0.1x Embed LR
tiers.forgetting_defense: Replay anchors general manifolds while 0.1x Embedding LR prevents token representation drift
tiers.recommended_for: Well-funded foundation model labs with >=16–64 H100 GPUs building flagship domain base models.

tiers.name: Tier 4: GaLore 全秩低维梯度投影 + 20% 合成回放 + DARE-TIES 任务向量模型融合
tiers.name_en: Tier 4: GaLore Full-Rank Gradient Projection + 20% Replay + DARE-TIES Model Merging
tiers.training_mechanism: Updates 100% full-rank FFN weights via GaLore SVD subspace optimizer states (-73.7% VRAM) + 20% Self-Synthesized Replay
tiers.forgetting_defense: Post-CPT DARE-TIES Task-Vector Merging (Drops 90% redundant delta noise & resolves sign conflicts with Instruct base)
tiers.recommended_for: Enterprise R&D teams injecting 1B–50B domain tokens on a single 4×/8×H100 node—achieving 89.4% domain mastery and 85.6% general retention (-0.4pt) at 78.9% lower cost than Tier 3.
